audit.why: 58.22% over 146 games matches the prose: Cassiopeia owns levels 2-6 and the first-item window, Vayne takes over at two items on Silver Bolts true damage. Early/mid/side-lane framing is right.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text names no real cooldowns and calls Final Hour's invisibility 'tumble invis' as if Tumble grants it by itself.
audit.why: Riot's text: Final Hour (R, 100/85/70s) grants Invisibility during Tumble. Before 6 Tumble has no stealth at all, so the pre-6 spikes were describing a level-6 effect.
audit.corrected: Tied the level 2-3 spike to Tumble's 6s rank-1 cooldown and the late spike to Final Hour granting the Tumble invisibility.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) 'she can land three autos for a Silver Bolts proc' — Silver Bolts counts the third consecutive attack OR ABILITY on the same target, so Condemn and Tumble's empowered hit both stack it. (b) 'the facing-stun beats her invis' asserts an invisibility interaction that Riot's text does not state; Petrifying Gaze's actual rule is that it stuns enemies facing Cassiopeia and only slows those with their backs turned.
audit.why: Riot text, Silver Bolts (W): 'The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's max health as bonus true damage.' Petrifying Gaze: 'stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned.'
audit.corrected: Stated the ability-stacking of Silver Bolts and replaced the invisibility claim with the verified facing rule: R her on the step-up, not on the retreat.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn is called matchup-defining but never given a number.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s. The whole trade cadence is 'commit while it is down'.
audit.corrected: Added 20s at rank 1 / 12s at rank 5 to the cooldown breakdown and the level 6 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Vayne as 'him/his' in tldr, winCon, tradeGood, dosFull and ahead.
audit.why: Vayne is female; the pronoun slip reads as boilerplate pasted from another matchup and undermines trust.
audit.corrected: Rewrote those strings in the user's second-person voice with correct pronouns and real ability names.

edits.before: With Q into E online you prime her with Noxious Blast then chain Twin Fang refunds — her tumble can dodge one hit but not the poison tick, so she takes a free trade she can't fully answer.
edits.after: With Q into E online, prime her with Noxious Blast then chain Twin Fang refunds — Tumble (Q) is a 6s cooldown at rank 1 and dodges one Fang, never the poison tick, so step up the moment she rolls.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze stuns her as she walks up to CS or right out of a tumble (her invis doesn't break a facing-stun), then you Twin Fang her flat before she can Condemn or reposition.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing you — a Vayne mid-Tumble away is merely slowed — so fire it as she steps up to CS, then Twin Fang her flat while Condemn sits on its 20s rank-1 cooldown.

edits.before: At 2+ items her Silver Bolts third hit deals percent-max-HP true damage that ignores your AP build, and tumble invis resets every trade — past her item spike she flips the lane and out-DPSes you.
edits.after: At 2+ items Silver Bolts' third hit is percent-max-HP true damage no AP build mitigates, and it stacks off abilities too, so Condemn counts. Final Hour turns every Tumble invisible — past that she flips the lane.

edits.before: Tumble (Q) sideways out of your Q poison line and into invis to dodge the cast that arms your Twin Fang refund
edits.after: Tumble (Q) out of your Noxious Blast zone on its 6s rank-1 cooldown, dodging the cast that arms your Twin Fang refund

edits.before: Drop W Miasma on her tumble exit or repositioning path to ground the dash and trap her in the poison cloud so your E keeps refunding
edits.after: Drop Miasma (W) on her Tumble exit — grounded she cannot roll out, and the cloud's slow plus poison keeps your Twin Fang refunding

edits.before: This is your window to own the lane. Ranks in Q and E let you chain Twin Fangs off your poison faster than she can land three autos for a Silver Bolts proc, and your levelled Serpentine Grace move speed plus Q's champion-hit speed buff mean you catch her kite instead of getting chipped. Hold W Miasma for the instant she tumbles to disengage or repositions — grounding her in the poison cloud disables the dash and locks the trade in your favour. At 6, Petrifying Gaze is the killshot: stun her as she walks up to CS or mid-tumble (the facing-stun beats her invis), then Twin Fang her flat before she can Condemn you off or reset.
edits.after: This is your window to own the lane. Ranks in Q and E let you chain Twin Fang off your poison faster than she stacks three hits for a Silver Bolts proc — and Condemn counts toward that stack, so it is three hits, not three autos. Your levelled Serpentine Grace plus Q's champion-hit move speed mean you catch her kite instead of getting chipped. Hold Miasma (W) for the instant she Tumbles to disengage: grounded, the roll is dead and she sits in your cloud. At 6, Petrifying Gaze only stuns targets facing you, so fire it as she steps up to CS, never as she runs, then Twin Fang her flat while Condemn burns its 20 seconds.

edits.before: At 2+ items her Silver Bolts third-hit percent-max-HP true damage shreds your resistance-light AP build and her tumble invis resets every trade — she out-scales you hard.
edits.after: At 2+ items her Silver Bolts third hit is percent-max-HP true damage your resistance-light AP build cannot answer, and Final Hour's Tumble invisibility resets every trade.

edits.before: Miasma is the anti-dash button — ground his engage and the dive kit becomes a farm bot.
edits.after: Miasma is the anti-dash button — ground her Tumble and Vayne's whole kite pattern stalls.

edits.before: Ground the engage, stun the commit, and melt him in the E-spam. Keep one eye on Condemn and one on the wave, in that order.
edits.after: Ground her Tumble, stun the step-up, and melt her in the Twin Fang chain. Keep one eye on Condemn's 20s and one on the wave.

edits.before: Q-poison his last-hit, E twice on the poison timer, drop W as he steps at you, and walk the grounded zone's edge while the fangs finish the math.
edits.after: Q-poison her last-hit, E twice on the poison timer, drop W as she rolls at you, and walk the grounded cloud's edge while the fangs finish it.

edits.after: Q-poison her last-hit, E twice on the poison timer, drop W as she rolls at you, and walk the grounded cloud's edge while the fangs finish it.

edits.before: Ahead, suffocate: poison Vayne off every wave, ground his trades into farce, and force fights at the pace only your mana pool sustains.
edits.after: Ahead, suffocate: poison Vayne off every wave, ground her Tumble into farce, and force fights at the pace only your mana pool sustains.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun — never fight her with terrain at your back. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Miasma has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — 20s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5. Never fight her with terrain at your back; count it down. - Your W Miasma has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
